verdict.rationale: Qodo documents an official Agentic Toolbox CLI that runs locally and can 'review changes before opening a pull request', so pre-PR local review from a CLI is covered. The CLI is framed around supplying skills to a coding agent, and nothing shows it running in CI scripts or emitting structured output. Missing for 10: documented CI-script/headless usage, machine-readable (e.g. JSON) review output, explicit local-diff targeting options, independent hands-on corroboration of CLI review.

support.subject: As a developer, I run reviews from a CLI against local diffs or in CI scripts, with machine-readable output my tooling can consume

citations.quote: Review changes before opening a pull request.
Use the Qodo Agentic Toolbox CLI when you want to use Qodo-managed skills locally.
